reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN units IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_missing_units,
       SUM(CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_missing_revenue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN unit_cost_eur IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_missing_cost
FROM sales
alternatives: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(*) - COUNT(units) AS lines_missing_units, COUNT(*) - COUNT(net_revenue_eur) AS lines_missing_revenue, COUNT(*) - COUNT(unit_cost_eur) AS lines_missing_cost FROM sales
